drivers: Europe growing about 35% against a mid-teens target
India business growing about 12% with new launches and approvals
Semaglutide partnership, Roche brands and HIV drug filings add new products
risks: Net debt about Rs 1,317 Cr after acquisitions
Debt-free target slipped from FY26 to FY28
Several launches came later than first promised
EMCURE.line: FY27 growth guidance raised to over 20% and most targets on track; the main slip is debt reduction.

drivers: New French retailer sourcing contract, about $550m a year of volume, not yet in the numbers
US online fashion client scaling up
risks: Missed more long-term targets than it hit (5-5-5 plan, profit, new businesses)
PDSL.line: Growth is strong right now, but management has missed more promises than it kept, so treat its targets with caution.

drivers: Price increases taken across ghee, milk and premium brands
Milk procurement scaled to 21 lakh litres a day
risks: Volume growth well below the double-digit aim (H1 flagship +3%)
Growth leaning on price rises rather than volumes
PARAGMILK.line: Sales growth is mostly from price rises, not volumes; new paneer capacity in mid-2027 is the next step. Guidance record only partly read.

drivers: Bangalore scaling to over Rs 3,000 Cr of pre-sales this year
Data-centre land sales of about Rs 1,500 Cr every six months; first build-to-suit deal due this year
Palava freeway opening, bullet train in 2029
risks: One H2 launch slipped into next year
Mid-income buyers could feel further rate rises
Margins above the 5-year norm; management calls them structural
LODHA.line: On track to beat its 20% profit growth target, with data centres and Bangalore as new engines. Read from the latest concall only.

drivers: Music margins widening as FY24-26 content pays back; 20-23% music growth and 60-65% EBITDA margin guided
Bhansali Productions stake with exclusive film music; Love & War album in Q4 FY27
Live events and artist management scaling; AI podcasts and videos for the old catalogue
risks: Weak cash conversion (CFO/PAT 0.49x in FY26) and an unexplained Rs 79 cr content-spend gap
Audit-trail gap flagged two years running; Rs 128 cr contingent liabilities incl. customs demand
Paid-subscription take-off repeatedly delayed; video shrinking and events loss-making by design
SAREGAMA.line: Management kept its 20-23% music growth path and FY27 content budget, and margins are now expanding, but cash conversion and accounting opacity are the watch points.
